rounds.summary: First pass of Scent Box Clean on Collection, Fragrance detail and Add fragrance (Mac-sized 1280x800 windows) plus Collection on iPhone 390x844, light and dark. Renders are in app/renders/r1/.
changes: Resting surfaces are open warm-white paper with a 1px hairline and no shadow; fields are underlined, rows are divided by hairlines.
The main action is a flat ink fill; chosen tabs, segments and chips fill ink; no other fill is used on the interface.
One sans (DM Sans) at regular and medium weight for everything.
Palette is ink and paper with a single muted brass accent so scent colours stay the only strong colour (sheet blocks cannot draw them yet).
Desktop sheet trimmed after the first render: filters merged into one line, accords cut to three, actions unpinned so they no longer cover content.

variants.change: material: open hairline paper with ink-fill selection

notes.text: Product-sheet blocks cannot draw bottle tints, accord chips or a card grid, so the scent colour that this style depends on is absent from every render; judge the look from the build pack plus the owner's web page.
The chosen segment is a heavy ink fill; consider an ink underline instead so it reads quieter.
iPhone pinned Add fragrance bar covers the Memories of Japan sampler rows; unpin or shorten the sheet.
Platform is one per sheet, so the desktop screens are Mac windows with a title bar and the iPhone screen is rendered from product-sheet-phone.md and merged into r1 by hand.

rounds.summary: Owner note on r1: "even simpler, probably more bento box". Moved from hairline paper to soft-tint tiles in a grid on a quiet ground. Renders are in app/renders/r2/ (Collection, Fragrance detail, Add fragrance as Mac windows; Collection on iPhone).
changes: Cards, stat tiles, fragrance tiles and fields are flat soft-tint tiles (dark: a lighter warm grey) with an 18px radius, no border, rule or shadow; controls are pills.
Fragrance tiles and the Memories of Japan sampler are drawn as a 2-column stat grid (house small, name, stars); stats are a single row of three tiles.
Removed section eyebrow labels on tabs and stats, chevrons and ruled lists; filters collapse to one quiet Filter link.
Chosen tab or segment is a soft tint pill with ink text, not a black block (pair-colour-tints added so the tint shows).
Primary action sits above the fold, so it no longer reads grey under the fold veil; iPhone has no pinned bar, Add is a header-style link.

variants.change: material: ruled hairline paper to soft-tint tiles (bento)
selected state: solid ink fill killed, tint pill kept

notes.text: Houses (18) is folded into the Filter link, not a fourth stat tile: the sheet stats grid cannot do four in one row without a 3+1 wrap. The fragrance tiles also cannot show format or accords or bottle tints.
Dark mode chosen pill is faint (warm dark tint on near-black); bold white text carries it.
